description: Upgrade your workspace with the Acer Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo — designed for comfort, performance, and productivity. The full-sized keyboard features 104 UV-printed keys with an integrated palm rest for all-day typing ease and durability, rated for 10 million keystrokes. Enjoy seamless 2.4GHz wireless connectivity with a nano receiver and up to 10 meters range. Whether you're working from home or the office, the Co-Pilot enabled shortcut keys and dedicated ₹ Rupee symbol key make this combo perfect for modern users. The compact, ergonomic mouse features a high-precision optical sensor with 1600 DPI and a 3-million click life, delivering smooth and responsive control. Both devices include smart power-saving features and low battery indicators. Compatible with Windows XP/7/8/10/11 and Mac OS, this plug & play combo is your ideal daily driver—reliable, sleek, and built to perform.
